finding: attack refused to swing below 30% health: 277 refusals in one run, 0 swings
fix: desperate mode for attack; survival skills skip the low-health kill
effect: the character fights back when cornered (run 4)

finding: the copper shortsword was treated as a 14-tile ranged weapon, so the character stabbed air: 0 kills in runs 1 to 5
fix: weapon reach from how the weapon is used (shortswords 1.8 tiles)
effect: first kills; survival suite 3/6 to 11/12

finding: scenarios started at spawn, which the Mac run had turned into a house and a mine shaft
fix: a flat arena rebuilt before every attempt
effect: every attempt fights on the same ground

finding: the escape started at 30% health with a zombie already on top: 6 and 7 deaths in 4 minutes
fix: hand control back at 50% with enemies near; dig_in bunker that fells trees, seals a roof and regenerates
effect: low-health scenarios pass (zombie_half_hp 6/6 across S2 and S3)

finding: the greedy walker cannot take a route that starts by moving away from the target
fix: A* over standing spots: walk, step, drop, gap jump; replans; greedy fallback
effect: nav suite 8/12 to 12/12; tunnel course 0/3 to 3/3

finding: the first detour course was unsolvable by any walker (stairs faced the wrong way)
fix: replaced it with the tunnel course; move_to reports whether A* or greedy drove it
effect: the A/B measures the walker, not the course

finding: two benchmark processes drove one game and cancelled each other's skills: a 0/8 run
fix: one exclusive lock per game instance
effect: a second driver exits with a clear message

finding: the check wanted the item named Wood; the model held 31 BorealWood and, when told it lacked Wood, crafted a BorealWoodWorkBench on its own
fix: checks follow Terraria's wood variants and recipe groups
effect: the model's correct adaptation now counts as a pass

finding: a task started on a floating island at height 66, above a 29-tile drop
fix: start and arena searches skip ground with a 10+ tile air gap below
effect: tasks start on real ground

finding: the model saved a skill with hard-coded coordinates; reused elsewhere, it walked to trees that were gone
fix: only coordinate-free programs enter the skill library
effect: saved skills carry over to new places

finding: scenarios used the Mac character (120 max life, extra gear), which flatters the numbers
fix: every scenario and task starts from a fresh character (starter kit, 100 life)
effect: results don't depend on what earlier runs left in the save

finding: the floating-island fix (an air-gap test) skipped real ground over caves and started tasks underground, invalidating a whole A/B pass
fix: island test by altitude; all 8 task start patches checked on the surface with trees before rerunning
effect: the A/B restarted on verified ground

finding: one furnace attempt ran 6918 s of wall clock inside a 180 s skill budget: timeouts count game ticks, and the sim was running far below 60 ticks/s
fix: a wall-clock budget next to the tick budget; every result reports ticks, wall seconds and tick rate
effect: a slow game can no longer hide a stuck skill

finding: mine_nearest tried ~100 trees one by one behind the same Ebonstone wall it could not dig
fix: targets past a blocked way are skipped; five unreachable in a row stops with the reason
effect: the same spot fails in 2-4 s with 'Ebonstone needs 65% pickaxe power' instead of hours

finding: the containers spent their CPU drawing frames nobody sees: ~21 ticks/s with the agent's own code at 0.4 s of CPU per 78 s skill
fix: headless mode (draw 1 frame in 1000) and fast-forward (k game ticks per frame); time limits and timings moved to the game's tick clock
effect: 60 ticks/s headless, ~500 at speed 8; the same 7-tree task takes the same 1639 ticks and ends on the same tile at 1x and 4x, in 3.5 s instead of 78 s

finding: one of three game instances crashed and its worker failed 27 jobs in a second as unreachable, which published a 3/30 suite
fix: jobs go back to the queue when an instance dies; runs with harness errors are flagged invalid automatically; a memory cap per world
effect: a crash costs time, not a wrong number on the page

finding: in a snow start the model asked for a WorkBench three times; craft only said 'Wood 0/10' while it held 35 BorealWood
fix: craft failures name the same item in a material you hold (BorealWoodWorkBench)
effect: workbench passes; on a fresh world per task the fresh pass got 5/8 and the learned pass 6/7, wood to door all on the first attempt

finding: a reused library skill aborted a furnace program for being 3 stone short of the check from the task it was learned on (the furnace needs 20, it had 27)
fix: a reused skill's old check is a note; the task's own check decides
effect: reused skills chain: hammer reused three saved skills in one program

finding: fast-forward made fights harder: with the world running between calls, every second the agent spends deciding costs 4 seconds of game, and the flier scenario fell from 3/3 at 1x to 1/3 at 4x
fix: survival suites run headless at 1x; fast-forward only where the world freezes while the agent thinks (LLM and build tracks)
effect: headless 1x survival suite 16/18, the best so far (15/18 rendered)

finding: task patches 120 tiles apart while tree search reaches 180 each way, and the model cut 30 trees a call: the fifth task found no tree in reach
fix: a fresh copy of the world before every task, each starting at the same patch with at least 10 trees
effect: chair_table, which failed in every earlier run, passed first try in both passes

finding: on a steep hillside no flat 3-tile floor was in reach, so the work bench could not be placed anywhere the character walked
fix: level a spot: mine a 3x3 space beside you, put a block under any open floor column, then place
effect: both failing hillside spots now craft the door

found_by: LLM track, furnace and copper tasks
finding: a tunnel stopped at grass with a tree on it ('did not break: something on top'); Terraria won't break a block under a tree
fix: fell the tree or cut the plant on top first, then break the block
effect: the same tunnel digs through (15 tiles)

finding: at 35 health with zombies 3 tiles away on both sides, dig_in (about 6 s of digging) died every time; the scenario sat at 1/3
fix: flee skill (run to the safer side, jump enemies and walls) before digging in; the bodyguard no longer stops a flee to fight
effect: first live run (Mac showcase): flee escaped, 25 tiles, nothing within 18; then the zombies caught up during the 6 s dig_in and it died. Next: run further before digging
